body:
## Pull request overview

This PR improves record detail rendering across `plugin-detail` and `plugin-grid` by using field-type-aware cell renderers (instead of `String(value)`), and adds currency auto-inference for grid columns to improve formatting and alignment.

**Changes:**
- Use `getCellRenderer(field.type)` for type-aware rendering in `DetailSection` and the ObjectGrid record detail panel (with fallback heuristics).
- Add currency/amount field-name inference to `inferColumnType`, plus coverage tests for the new behavior.
- Propagate additional field metadata from console object definitions into the generated detail-view schema.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 8 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Adds `@object-ui/fields` to `plugin-detail` but also removes `examples/hotcrm/packages/*` importers from the lockfile. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Adds currency inference to `inferColumnType`; enhances record detail rendering using schema field types + fallback heuristics. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/airtable-style.test.tsx | Adds a test ensuring currency/amount fields are inferred and formatted. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Renders field values via `getCellRenderer` when `field.type` is available. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.test.tsx | Adds tests covering type-aware rendering for date/currency/boolean/select. |
| packages/plugin-detail/package.json | Adds `@object-ui/fields` dependency. |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Passes `options`/reference metadata/currency into DetailView fields. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the feature work as completed. |
</details>

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**pnpm-lock.yaml:577**
* `pnpm-workspace.yaml` includes `examples/hotcrm/packages/*` (and `examples/hotcrm` is a git submodule), but this lockfile no longer contains any `examples/hotcrm/packages/*` importers. This will break installs in environments that check out submodules (e.g. Vercel/CI). Regenerate `pnpm-lock.yaml` with the submodule initialized (e.g. `git submodule update --init examples/hotcrm`) and then run `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` so the hotcrm importers are present again.
</details>

`detailSchema.sections[].fields[]` now forwards `options`/`reference_to`/`currency` and uses `fieldDef.type` values intended for `@object-ui/fields`, but `DetailViewField` in `@object-ui/types` doesn’t currently include these properties/types. To avoid schema typing drift in the console app, consider typing `detailSchema` as `DetailViewSchema` and aligning the DetailView field type with `FieldMetadata` (or extending `DetailViewField` accordingly).

Test name says it renders a boolean field "with badge", but the assertion (and the renderer) is for a checkbox. Renaming the test to match the actual UI behavior will make failures easier to interpret.

This change relies on `field.type` values like `currency`/`boolean`/`select` and passes `field` into `getCellRenderer`, but the `DetailViewField` type in `@object-ui/types` doesn’t model these field types or the required metadata (e.g. `options`, `currency`, `reference_to`). This forces `any` and makes the DetailView schema typings inaccurate. Consider updating `DetailViewField` to reuse/extend `FieldMetadata` (or expanding its union + adding metadata props) so type-aware rendering is type-safe for consumers.

Fixed in 4575e39. Extended `DetailViewField` in `@object-ui/types` with the data-oriented field types (`currency`, `boolean`, `select`, `lookup`, etc.) and metadata properties (`options`, `reference_to`, `reference_field`, `currency`). The `detailSchema` in `RecordDetailView.tsx` is now typed as `DetailViewSchema`.
Fixed in 4575e39. Renamed to "should render boolean fields with checkbox".

Fixed in 4575e39. `DetailViewField` now includes the full set of data-oriented types and metadata props (`options`, `reference_to`, `reference_field`, `currency`). The `renderField` parameter is typed as `DetailViewField` (no longer `any`), and the `getCellRenderer` call uses an explicit cast to `FieldMetadata`.
